name: _login.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_login.scss — the admin login surface: centered card, Google
//  sign-in button, loading/error states, dark-console styling.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Admin Login Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
.admin-login-wrapper {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, $cms-bg-dark 0%, $cms-bg-darkest 70%);
  padding: 2rem;
}

// The login card panel.
.admin-login-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: $cms-card-max-width;
  background: rgba(31, 40, 51, 0.65);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  text-align: center;

  .admin-title {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: $color-white;
  }

  .admin-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: $cms-text-subtle;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }

  .google-auth-btn {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
    background: $color-white;
    color: $color-black;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;

    &:hover {
      background: $color-grey-2;
      transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-2xs)));
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }

    &:disabled {
      opacity: 0.6;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      transform: none;
    }

    .google-icon {
      width: var(--space-xl);
      height: var(--space-xl);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
  }

  .admin-error-msg {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    background: rgba(255, 75, 75, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 75, 75, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: $cms-error;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }
}
